messages:
Alex: Bringing up ceres-14b (int4) on dedicated-4xA100. Hitting OOMs with concurrent_batch=4 + max_new_tokens=1024. Looks like a sudden kv-cache allocation spike.

Alex: stack snippet:
```
E: OutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate 1.2GB for KV cache
   at inference/kv_cache.cc:187
   at runtime/dispatcher.cc:402
```
Alex: Anyone seen this with other 14B-class int4 brings?

Maria: saw something similar when we enabled aggressive prefetch for phoenix -> allocator fragmentation. Can you paste model config and the serving flags?

Alex: config we used:
```
model: ceres-14b-int4
concurrency: 4
max_new_tokens: 1024
enable_prefetch: true
kv_window: 2048
quant: int4_narrow
```

Keenan: two quick suspects: prefetch+large kv_window can blow transient mem before compaction, and glibc arenas fragment under many threads. For int4 we usually turn prefetch off and cap max_new_tokens to 512 as the per-model default.

Keenan: try these runtime tweaks first:
- set MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=4 (or switch to jemalloc)
- disable prefetch for ceres by default
- reduce per-request max_new_tokens to 512 for this model

Sophie: also watch quality: int4 + smaller window can slightly change recency for long chats. Have eval prompts ready? we should run the regression suite when you change defaults. :mag:

Alex: running quick A/B now. Reduced max_new_tokens to 512 and set enable_prefetch=false. Will flip MALLOC_ARENA_MAX next.

DeployBot: canary deploy queued for model=ceres-14b-int4 -> pool=dedicated-4xA100 by Alex at 1823456805 :rocket:

Samir: if MALLOC tweak doesn't cut it, add periodic runtime compaction and reduce thread-local cache. Example env+sysctl we use on prod:
```bash
export MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=4
export LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/libjemalloc.so
echo 1 > /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory  # one-shot trigger
```
Also consider lowering default batch_target_tokens from 2048 -> 1024 to reduce peak staging memory.

Alex: applied MALLOC_ARENA_MAX and disabled prefetch. Canary ran 2000 requests w/ mixed lengths (avg 350 new tokens) and OOMs dropped to 0. Quality delta ~+0.4 perplexity on our RW eval (within threshold).

Alex: Action items: 1) update model defaults for ceres-14b-int4: max_new_tokens=512, enable_prefetch=false, batch_target_tokens=1024; 2) add mem-frag check to onboarding checklist; 3) run full eval (Sophie) and then promote to dedicated pool if green. I'll open a ticket with logs and the config diff. :white_check_mark:
